headline: US-Iran Peace Deal Signals End to Energy Turmoil, Paving Way for AI Sector Boom
summary: The newly announced peace deal between the United States and Iran is a major geopolitical de-escalation, fundamentally reshaping global energy markets by ending a prolonged period of conflict. This move is expected to alleviate energy supply concerns and remove significant investment obstacles, thereby indirectly benefiting capital-intensive sectors like AI infrastructure and semiconductor fabs.
